pairs.subject: data-video-art-direction
pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/video/types.ts:1 These files are vendor transports (image providers, the browser-driven Studio driver, the image-to-clip hop with its price and budget) and contain no frame, chart, theme, card or title design; a search of lib/imaging/providers, lib/imaging/studio and lib/imaging/video for 'bar race', 'statreel', 'champion', 'leaderboard', 'data-video' and 'data video' found nothing, so the subject's precondition (designing the look of a narration-free data video) does not hold here.

pairs.subject: data-video-art-direction
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Strips.tsx:3 The only chart-like surface in these editors is the narrated explainer's strips grid, where voice lines play under each card and the screen only reviews cards already drawn; a search of the _edit directory for 'bar race', 'statreel', 'champion', 'leaderboard', 'data-video' and 'data video' found nothing, so these review screens never design a narration-free data-video frame.

pairs.subject: data-video-art-direction
pairs.evidence: lib/frames/frames.ts:16 Frames turns the beats of a narrated script (each carrying its spoken sentence) into plate, vector-element and text layers, so it is about narrated explainers and not a narration-free race or chart video; a search of lib/frames for 'bar race', 'statreel', 'champion', 'leaderboard', 'data-video' and 'data video' found nothing.

pairs.subject: data-video-art-direction
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/page.tsx:1 The ledger is an append-only event list with facets and a per-day strip, so it draws no data-video frame; a search of app/(studio)/ledger for 'bar race', 'statreel', 'champion', 'leaderboard', 'data-video' and 'data video' found nothing (its one 'race' hit is an async-race-guard comment).

pairs.subject: data-video-art-direction
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/kit/ProduceKit.tsx:3 The kit renders @gt/ui specimens of studio screens from fixed fixture data, and its palettes and 'photo' strings describe still styles, not a data-video frame; a search of app/(studio)/kit for 'bar race', 'statreel', 'champion', 'leaderboard', 'data-video' and 'data video' found nothing.
